label: rare: fed-back a during copy phase
explanation: Very sparse feature (~0.003% of steps). About 84% of activation mass is in the copy phase, and 78% of activations fall where the fed-back input is the letter a (lift 25x), most often on the last copy step (to_go=0, 53% of mass) and at recall_idx 3 (e.g. x h a w <DEL> x h [a]). Activations are higher for digit-free sequences and when the token before the a is h/b/e/d/k/u. The other ~16% is in the original phase at t=3-5, mostly in sequences that start with a (e.g. a o x [c]). It never fires at t<3 or on the delimiter. Precision is extremely low: only about 0.14% of copy-phase a inputs activate it, and adding conditions on previous/output tokens gets precision to only ~3%, so the feature is reading some rare hidden-state configuration that the token-level variables do not capture. Magnitude is nearly flat (0.10-0.16); the top activations are copy-phase a inputs.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues.
